summary_en: TOWA Pharmaceutical delayed the stock transfer completion date for acquiring all shares of Tanabe Pharma Factory Co., Ltd. from Tanabe Pharma Co., Ltd. from end-November 2026 to end-December 2026 to allow adequate preparation time for smooth post-acquisition integration.
title_en: Notice on Change in Stock Transfer Execution Date for Acquisition of All Shares of Tanabe Pharma Factory Co., Ltd. from Tanabe Pharma Co., Ltd. (Full Subsidiary Status)
translation_en_brief:
TOWA Pharmaceutical announced a postponement of the stock transfer execution date for its acquisition of all shares of Tanabe Pharma Factory Co., Ltd. from its parent company Tanabe Pharma Co., Ltd. The completion date has been moved from the end of November 2026 to the end of December 2026.

The two companies agreed to this one-month delay to ensure adequate preparation time for smooth post-acquisition integration. Both parties are carefully reviewing the transition process together and determined that extending the timeline would allow for sufficient preparation period to facilitate successful business combination.

The company stated that the impact of this timing change on its consolidated financial forecasts for the fiscal year ending March 2027 will be immaterial. TOWA noted that negative goodwill is expected to arise from the acquisition, but the amount and its impact on fiscal 2027 forecasts will be disclosed once details are finalized.
